answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 81 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in vault, queued in sparrow, and signal publishes the wait time. A farm of 328 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4326 identities would post 3055 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
